# Project Titan — Live Global & Hyper-Local Telemetry Hub
> Real-time, edge-cached aggregator for hyper-local community incident reports, live event maps, international space telemetry (ISS), global flight radar, and live commodity/crypto tickers.

## Live Machine-Readable Endpoints
- `/api/summary`: Aggregated real-time telemetry snapshot (JSON, updated every 15s)
- `/local`: Interactive hyper-local event map and community incident feed
- `/finance`: Spot Gold/Silver and real-time crypto indices
- `/space`: Live ISS orbital coordinates and telemetry
